title: The Payatas Foot Rugs That Became Rags2Riches in 2007
conflicts: Pre-R2R earnings vary slightly (12-16 pesos for ten rugs, Tatler 2022; 10-16 pesos a day, Philstar 2020; 10-12 pesos, an artisan in Philstar 2013; about 20 US cents, WEF 2018); the story uses her Tatler figure with attribution. Later scale conflicts (1,000+ artisans trained per WEF 2018 vs 200 artisans across eight communities per Tatler 2022), so neither is used. Founding November 2007 (Philstar 2010) vs registered January 2008 (MoneySense); story says 2007.
notes: Nine co-founders (MoneySense); founder field names only Fernandez-Ruiz. 700-pieces bazaar sale and five-times earnings are single-source and attributed. Inquirer and Devex profiles return 403 and were not used.
